name: Al Obeikan Glass Company
summary: Al Obeikan Glass Company specializes in the wholesale and retail distribution of chemicals and diverse glass products, serving markets both domestically in Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through distinct Glass and Aluminum segments. Beyond its core offerings, Al Obeikan is involved in quarry management and the operation of sand and gravel mines, including associated crushing facilities. It also manufactures and supplies a range of glass types, such as float, laminated, and insulating glass, primarily utilized in construction. Additionally, the firm offers consultation services. Established in 2006, Al Obeikan Glass Company is headquartered in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
